title: Auguste de Saint-Hilaire, Voyage dans les provinces de Rio de Janeiro et de Minas Geraes, vol. 2, pp. 47-48: 'Le vocabulaire suivant pourra donner quelque idée du macuni'
language_as_named: Macuni (Indiens d'Alto dos Bois, Minas Gerais)
evidence: Dieu, Tupci. Ciel, betcoi ... Soleil, apucaai ... Eau, conahan. Homme, etpôr. Femme, ati ... Miel, paug
novelty_basis: Glottolog macu1258 lists only Loukotka 1968 and Martius 1867; Saint-Hilaire's list is not among Glottolog refs, but it is catalogued by Valle Cabral 1881 ('Vocabulaire Maconi') and very likely reproduced in Martius 1867 Glossaria, so it is a standard source, not new
notes: Useful primary source to add to Glottolog references; note Saint-Hilaire's comparison with Monoxó.
